scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api,worker --prefix-colors blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @ctrorec/web dev" "pnpm --filter @ctrorec/api dev" "pnpm --filter @ctrorec/worker dev"
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @ctrorec/database test:integration && pnpm --filter @ctrorec/api test:integration && pnpm --filter @ctrorec/worker test:integration
scripts.backup:create: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @ctrorec/worker build && pnpm --filter @ctrorec/worker backup:create
scripts.backup:restore-drill: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @ctrorec/worker build && pnpm --filter @ctrorec/worker backup:restore-drill
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
